objects.name: Syrian Electronic Army (SEA)
objects.description: The Syrian Electronic Army is a pro-regime hacking collective that CrowdStrike historically tracked as DEADEYE JACKAL; CrowdStrike later renamed its Syria-nexus adversary tracking to DEADEYE HAWK.

x_alias_assessments.name: Deadeye Jackal
x_alias_assessments.analyst_notes: CrowdStrike's 2015 report states that it tracked the Syrian Electronic Army as DEADEYE JACKAL. Scope remains overlapping because the vendor tracking boundary may not be identical to the public SEA label.

x_alias_assessments.name: Deadeye Hawk
x_alias_assessments.analyst_notes: CrowdStrike's 2023 report renamed its Syria-nexus adversary from DEADEYE JACKAL to DEADEYE HAWK. This is retained as a scoped rename rather than an exact identity assertion.
